budget.title: Half-Day Szentendre Nature Budget Plan
budget.summary: A short, peaceful nature-focused route with affordable local food — perfect for a calm half-day escape.

schedule.title: Danube Riverside Walk
schedule.description: Start your morning with a relaxed walk along the riverbank — fresh air, quiet paths, and great views.

schedule.title: Bükkös Creek Nature Path
schedule.description: Continue your walk along the creek — a small green corridor with wooden bridges and calm scenery.

schedule.title: Budget Local Snack
schedule.description: Grab something simple and tasty like lángos, a cheese pastry, or goulash soup from a local spot.

comfortable.title: Half-Day Szentendre Nature Comfort Tour
comfortable.summary: A relaxing nature route with a comfortable lunch and scenic walking paths.

schedule.title: Morning Coffee & Danube Stroll
schedule.description: Begin with a nice coffee at a riverside café and take a slow, scenic walk.

schedule.title: Creekside Walk Through Green Areas
schedule.description: Follow the quiet creek path — shady trees, soft sounds of water, and peaceful atmosphere.

schedule.title: Comfortable Local Lunch
schedule.description: A traditional Hungarian lunch in a cozy restaurant — hearty but not too heavy.

budget.title: Half-Day Veggie-Friendly Nature Budget Route
budget.summary: A light and affordable vegetarian-friendly nature walk through Szentendre.

schedule.title: Light Breakfast + Riverside Walk
schedule.description: Grab a pastry or fruit from a bakery and take a refreshing walk along the Danube.

schedule.title: Veggie-Friendly Creek Walk
schedule.description: A peaceful trail along Bükkös Creek — ideal for a calm half-day trip.

schedule.title: Budget Veggie Lunch
schedule.description: Choose a small café offering salads, vegetable soups, or simple vegetarian dishes.

comfortable.title: Half-Day Veggie Nature Comfort Plan
comfortable.summary: A comfortable half-day nature route with healthy vegetarian dining.

schedule.title: Vegetarian Café Breakfast
schedule.description: Granola, croissants, or a plant-based breakfast plate to start the day right.

schedule.title: Creekside Green Walk
schedule.description: Follow the shady walking path along Bükkös Creek for a refreshing outdoor experience.

schedule.title: Comfortable Veggie Lunch
schedule.description: A refined vegetarian lunch at a bistro serving bowls, salads, or pasta.

budget.title: Half-Day Nature Tasting Route (Budget)
budget.summary: A fun half-day exploring nature while trying small bites along the way.

schedule.title: Bakery Tasting Start
schedule.description: Choose two or three pastries and enjoy them while walking by the Danube.

schedule.title: Bükkös Creek Walk & Snacks
schedule.description: Continue your tasting experience with light snacks as you explore the creek path.

schedule.title: Street Food Bite
schedule.description: Try a quick snack like lángos or a simple sandwich before wrapping up the tour.

comfortable.title: Half-Day Nature Tasting Comfort Tour
comfortable.summary: A tasting-style mini route through Szentendre’s nature with comfortable food stops.

schedule.title: Cozy Café Breakfast Tasting
schedule.description: Start with coffee and a couple of small pastries or breakfast items.

schedule.title: Calm Creek Walk
schedule.description: Walk through one of Szentendre’s quietest green areas — refreshing and scenic.

schedule.title: Shared Tasting Plates
schedule.description: Enjoy a few small dishes at a comfortable restaurant — light, varied, and satisfying.
